name: 5M Pretraining Baseline & Pipeline Verification
objective: Verify basic autoregressive training loop, BPE tokenization, and cross-entropy loss convergence.
parameter_reconciliation_note: 16,768,128 is the PyTorch-verified parameter count in checkpoints/exp_100m/best_val.pt; 16,252,800 was an early historical registry metadata estimate.
outcome: Model converged from high random entropy to 6.03 loss; exhibited phrase-level repetitive degeneration under greedy decoding.

name: 25M Pretraining Scale-Up & Grammar Emergence
objective: Observe perplexity scaling and grammar acquisition by increasing pretraining budget 5x to 25M tokens.
parameter_reconciliation_note: 16,768,128 is the PyTorch-verified parameter count in checkpoints/exp_100m/best_val.pt; 16,252,800 was an early historical registry metadata estimate.
outcome: Achieved 61.4% perplexity reduction over 5M baseline; demonstrated emergent syntactic structures and lexical cohesion.

name: 16.8M Pretraining Baseline (100M Tokens)
objective: Establish reference small-scale language model baseline on a curated 100M token multi-source corpus.
parameter_reconciliation_note: 16,768,128 is the PyTorch-verified parameter count in checkpoints/exp_100m/best_val.pt; 16,252,800 was an early historical registry metadata estimate.
outcome: Validation perplexity reached 47.53 (68.9% reduction over 25M); generated clean English paragraphs, but scored 0% on reasoning tasks without SFT.

name: 16.8M Supervised Syntax & Capability Diagnostic
objective: Test whether 4 epochs on 500 strictly isolated examples enables instruction following, syntax compliance, and held-out generalization.
parameter_reconciliation_note: 16,768,128 is the PyTorch-verified parameter count in checkpoints/exp_100m/best_val.pt; 16,252,800 was an early historical registry metadata estimate.
outcome: Demonstrated rapid syntax internalization (77.5% Python AST, 67.5% JSON syntax), but identified severe semantic bottleneck (0% functional pass on unseen task families).

name: 50M Grouped-Query Attention (GQA-4) Pretraining
objective: Scale model capacity to 50M parameters and evaluate Grouped-Query Attention (4 KV heads) on a 250M-token corpus.
outcome: Unlocks 52.6% perplexity reduction over 16M baseline. GQA-4 matches MHA perplexity while halving KV-cache size.

name: 50M Deep-Thin Architectural Ablation
objective: Compare a deep-thin topology (16 layers, 448 dim) against wide topology at equal 50M parameter budget.
outcome: Deep-thin performance (3.1687) was nearly identical to standard 12-layer GQA-4 (3.1637), but exhibited higher sequential execution latency.

name: 100M Full Pretraining across 1.5 Billion Tokens
objective: Scale model capacity to 100M parameters (14 layers, 768 dim, 12 heads, 4 KV heads) trained across 1.5B tokens.
outcome: Best pretraining loss in project history (PPL 15.08); rich linguistic and factual base representations formed.

name: 100M Long-Context Extension (4,096 Tokens) & Passkey Retrieval
objective: Extend context window 8x from 512 to 4,096 tokens via RoPE linear frequency scaling without resetting weights.
outcome: Context window successfully expanded to 4,096 tokens with zero perplexity explosion or gradient instability.

name: 100M Supervised Fine-Tuning Baseline (ChatML Formatting)
objective: Initial ChatML fine-tuning on 10k instruction examples.
outcome: Established basic ChatML format adherence; responses remained brief and brittle under complex prompts.

name: 100M Supervised Fine-Tuning Scale-Up (29k Records)
objective: Scale fine-tuning dataset to 29k records with enriched code and JSON schemas.
outcome: Improved code execution syntax and structure; began displaying email boilerplate contamination.

name: 100M Overfitting Diagnostic & Conversational Analysis
objective: 3-epoch training on 35k records aimed at achieving maximum instruction following.
outcome: Lowest loss in project history (0.765), but revealed catastrophic conversational failure (inability to handle greetings, template lock-in). Triggered Phase 0 Forensic Audit.

name: Forensic Root-Cause Analysis of Conversational Degradation
objective: Diagnose mathematical and data-distribution root causes of conversational breakdown in SFT v3.
outcome: Discovered conversational starvation (9 greeting records out of 34,700 = 0.026% by records; 216 supervised tokens out of ~7.2M = 0.003% by tokens), template domination (56.5% tokens in 2 templates), and 80:1 microbatch loss weighting distortion.

name: Token-Weighted Cross-Entropy Formulation & Verification
objective: Formulate, implement, and verify global token-weighted cross-entropy loss to eliminate gradient bias.
outcome: Passed Tests A-J with 100% mathematical precision. Loss perfectly weights every supervised token equally regardless of microbatch sequence lengths.

name: QORIN-500M Pretraining Campaign (5B-Token Target)
objective: Train full 500M parameter model across 5B tokens on 7 interleaved domains with 1:45/15 thermal cycle on local RTX 5060 GPU.
outcome: Readiness audit, VRAM feasibility, sustained throughput benchmark, and pilot run passed with 100% bit-exact resumption; main training actively progressing.
